metadata.title: Reeses Peanut Butter Cup Martini - TheFNDC.com
metadata.description:
http://www.thefndc.com/ The Reese's Peanut Buter Cup Martini: heaven in a glass. What will you need to make this amazing cocktail? Peanut butter is a given, choclate vodka, creme de cacao, Frangelico, Kahlua, half and half, chocolate syrup, and Reeses peanut butter cups complete the ingredient list.

Coat a frosted martini glass with chocolate syrup, shake the rest of the ingredients with ice until the peanut butter is dissolved. Pour and garnish with peanut butter cups, eat the remaining Reeses, because you know you want to.

Thanks to viewer tenhundredkills for sending us this request.

REESES PEANUT BUTTER CUP MARTINI
===================================
1 oz Frangelico
1 oz Kahlua
1 oz creme de cacao
1 oz chocolate vodka
2-3 tsp peanut butter (add more if you want)
2 oz half and half
Chocolate syrup
Reese's peanut butter cups

nodes.plm_caption:
The video is for the Reeses Peanut Butter Cup Martini recipe. It shows a man making it in his backyard. There are lots of bottles on a table in the background. The video is in fast motion with a few short cuts to other shots.
In the first shot, a Reeses peanut butter cup martini is shown, with the cup tilted to the left. Then, the video cuts to the man.

The man first opens a purple bag with black text and pours a brown bottle with yellow and black text into a glass with ice. He pours in another yellow bottle with red and white text, then pours cream from the cream bag. He shakes, taps his fists on the table and pours out the drink. He places ice on a glass, shakes, taps his fists again, pours the drink into the glass and sticks a red and white cream wafer on the rim of the drink.

Then the video cuts to a black screen with white text that reads "Drinks With Diablo | a Presentation of | theFND. com |".  The next shot shows the man, but without the drink, putting ice into a glass.

To the right, he picks up another bottle (partially obscured by a white bag) and shakes it then, taps his fist on the table, shakes it again, stops, pours the drink into the glass then he taps his fist once more on the table. He picks up a glass of beer with his right hand.

summary.brief: Johnny Diablo mixes a Reese’s Peanut Butter Cup Martini and tastes the finished drink.
summary.detailed: The video opens with a close‑up of a frosted martini glass holding a finished Reese’s Peanut Butter Cup Martini, the glass tipped slightly to the left. It then cuts to Johnny Diablo, who greets the audience and lists the ingredients: 1 oz each of Frangelico, Kahlua, crème de cacao, and chocolate vodka; 2 oz half‑and‑half; a heaping teaspoon of peanut butter; chocolate syrup; and Reese’s peanut‑butter cups for garnish. He measures one ounce of each liqueur, adds the peanut butter and half‑and‑half into a shaker, fills the shaker with ice, rims the frosted glass with chocolate syrup, and shakes vigorously until the peanut butter is fully dissolved and the mixture becomes fluffy. He strains the cocktail into the syrup‑rimmed glass, creates a small divot on a Reese’s cup and places the cup on the rim as garnish. He samples the drink, declares it delicious, thanks the viewer who requested it, shows a slide summarising the recipe, and the segment finishes with him opening a bottle of beer.

action.detailed: Measure and pour the liqueurs, peanut butter, and half‑and‑half into a shaker with ice, rim the martini glass with chocolate syrup, shake until smooth, strain into the glass, and garnish with a Reese’s peanut‑butter cup.
action.actor: Johnny Diablo, the host of Drinks with Diablo

The video shows a person making a drink outdoors. On a table next to the person are several bottles and glasses, and they make a drink in one of the glasses. They then take a drink from the glass and set it back down. Next they pour an ice cube from the jigger into the glass and another jigger of ice on top of it. They then pick up a bottle and pour a brown liquid into the glass.
At 0:12 they set the bottle down and pick up another. They then pick up a jar and pour something from it into the glass. The person then takes a jar from a nearby location and puts a block of ice in the glass and shakes the mixture around. When the person stops shaking the drink the brown liquid is no longer visible. Next they set the block of ice aside and pick up a glass on the side.
At 0:21, a person picks up the glasses again and pours liquid from one glass to the other. They then shake the mixture, stop, and set it down. They then use a wooden item to spin the drink in the glass. Next, they hold up a box on the table and pick up an orange object, they place it in the glass and shake it until the orange substance is sprayed. They then set the orange object down.
At the end of the video, the person puts both the glasses on the table and they show off the drink they have made, and the bottle the drink came from.
In the background is an area that is overgrown with palm trees and the fence. The video takes place outside during the day.

summary.brief: Johnny Diablo prepares a Reese’s Peanut Butter Cup Martini.
summary.detailed: Johnny Diablo greets the audience and introduces the Reese’s Peanut Butter Cup Martini, listing the required liqueurs—Frangelico, crème de cacao, chocolate vodka, Kahlúa—plus chocolate syrup, peanut butter, and half‑and‑half, with Reese’s cups for garnish. He coats the rim of a frosted martini glass with chocolate syrup, then measures one ounce of each liqueur into a shaker, adds two to three heaping teaspoons of peanut butter, two ounces of half‑and‑half, a splash of chocolate syrup, and fills the shaker with ice. He shakes the mixture until the peanut butter fully dissolves and the cocktail becomes fluffy, strains it into the prepared glass, and garnishes it by cutting a small divot in a Reese’s Peanut Butter Cup and placing it on the rim. Finally he presents the drink, tastes it, and declares it a delicious, peanut‑butter‑and‑chocolate concoction.

action.detailed: Coat a frosted martini glass rim with chocolate syrup, combine one ounce each of Frangelico, crème de cacao, chocolate vodka, and Kahlúa with 2–3 teaspoons of peanut butter, two ounces of half‑and‑half, chocolate syrup and ice in a shaker, shake until smooth, strain into the glass, and garnish with a cut Reese’s Peanut Butter Cup.
action.actor: Johnny Diablo, the host of Drinks With Diablo

The video features an outdoor drinking gathering where a man with a bald spot discusses and demonstrates making a seasonal cocktail. The scene is set against a palm tree and fence backdrop.
In the beginning, a man is seen standing behind a bar with a black table top that displays alcohol bottles and other objects. The man appears to have a lively discussion on how he makes his alcoholic beverage. He touches his bald spot, points to his belly, and begins to gesture towards the table.
To the man's left, we see an outdoor palm tree. To his right, there is a tall wooden fence and several trees.

summary.brief: Host Johnny Diablo stands behind an outdoor bar, points at the bottles and shakes an ice‑filled glass while talking.
summary.detailed: Johnny Diablo, a balding man with a moustache wearing a black T‑shirt, stands behind a black‑topped outdoor bar loaded with assorted liquor bottles. He rests his left hand on the bar, points at the bottles with his right hand, brings his hand to his face while speaking, and then lifts a bottle toward the camera as he mentions the Reese’s garnish. He then grabs a clear glass filled with ice, shakes it briefly, and continues gesturing and talking against a backdrop of a palm tree, a wooden fence and trees under a clear blue sky.

action.detailed: Point at the bottles, raise a bottle toward the camera, then pick up the ice‑filled glass and shake it while speaking.
action.actor: Host Johnny Diablo, a balding man with a moustache wearing a black T‑shirt

nodes.plm_caption: A man with a black t-shirt on stands behind a black table with alcohol and drinks bottles on it. He holds a glass and speaks to the camera. He moves his arm to the left and the right and removes the lid off a bottle. There are trees and a fence behind him.

summary.brief: A man in a black T‑shirt removes a bottle cap and pours a dark liquor into an ice‑filled glass at an outdoor bar.
summary.detailed: The man wearing a black T‑shirt stands behind a black tabletop crowded with bottles, glasses, a bag of ice and a small container. He looks at the camera, gestures with his hands, and moves his arm left and right. He lifts a bottle, removes its cap, then tilts the bottle to pour a dark liquid into a glass that already contains ice. While doing so he nudges the small container on the table aside. Tropical plants, a wooden fence and bright sunlight are visible in the background.

action.detailed: Remove the bottle’s cap, lift the bottle, and tilt it to pour its dark contents into the ice‑filled glass, moving the small container on the table aside as you do so.
action.actor: The man wearing a black T‑shirt behind the outdoor bar

nodes.plm_caption:
This video features a man standing behind a bar, wearing a black t-shirt with a yellow logo, he's talking about the ingredients he uses and pouring liquor into a glass. Then it cuts to a woman with long, red hair who sits down next to him.
The man pours the liquor over an ice cube in a glass, then adds a second type of liquor, as she enters, he adds a third type of liquor. The man is wearing a black t-shirt with a yellow logo.
There are trees, a wooden fence and a blue sky in the background of the video. The video cuts from the man at the bar to the woman, who is seated on a chair.

summary.brief: Man pours several liquors into an ice‑filled glass while a red‑haired woman watches.
summary.detailed: The man, wearing a black T‑shirt with a yellow logo, stands at an outdoor bar and talks about the ingredients. He first measures and pours a dark brown spirit over the ice in a glass, then adds a clear liquor, and finally a third spirit, opening each bottle’s cap and using a small metal jigger for the later pours. As he continues, a woman with long red hair enters the frame and watches him from the side.

action.detailed: Measure and pour each liquor into the ice‑filled glass while opening each bottle’s cap, as a red‑haired woman watches.
action.actor: the man in the black T‑shirt with a yellow logo

nodes.plm_caption:
A man and a woman are both standing behind a table covered in alcohol bottles and mixers. The man is showing her how to make the drink.
The woman is standing beside him and watching closely. She moves over to touch his hand and then goes to the other side. At the end, she looks at him and smiles while he pours in his last ingredient.

summary.brief: The man opens bottles, measures and pours liquor into an ice‑filled glass while the woman watches and smiles.
summary.detailed: The segment opens with the man in a black T‑shirt removing caps and spinning a bottle as a woman with long red hair leans forward, briefly touches his hand and then steps to the other side of the counter. He then uncaps several bottles, fills a small jigger with a clear spirit and pours it into a glass that already contains ice, repeats the measuring and pouring with another bottle, and gives the mixture a quick stir. As he adds the final ingredient, the woman looks at him and smiles.

action.detailed: Remove the caps of the bottles, measure each liquor with a jigger and pour it into the ice‑filled glass, then stir the mixture.
action.actor: The man wearing a black T‑shirt

The video shows a man measuring and pouring ingredients into a mixing glass. In a tropical setting.
At the start of the video, the man is in centre screen, holding up a large bottle of what appears to be rum. He puts it down and holds up the lid. He picks up another bottle, held down by his left hand, and holds the lid with his right hand. The cap is removed. Then, he puts the bottle down and picks up a third bottle, with a red label, but looks like peanut butter. In the background are large tropical trees and a wooden fence.

nodes.plm_action: Put the ingredients into the shaker.
nodes.plm_caption:
The video is a Montage of a guy who is preparing a cocktail. There are bottles of alcohol, mixers, and other things on a table in front of the guy, who is standing up. He mixes everything in a clear glass that is on the table, then proceeds to mix the whole thing up in a metal cup. Then it is ready to pour in an alcohol bottle.
The guy is a white man with a bald head. He is wearing a dark shirt. He seems to be in a backyard, and there are some plants behind him. He seems to be concentrating mostly on what he is doing.
The video is a Montage.
There is a bottle of vodka in front of the guy. There are other bottles and alcohol as well, and mixers. There are some other objects that are not clear.

summary.brief: A man adds powders, ice cream, ice and sugar to a mixing glass, shakes the cocktail, and pours it into a martini glass, repeating the shake‑and‑pour.
summary.detailed: The segment opens with a bald man in a dark shirt standing at an outdoor bar. He opens a jar and pours a brown powder into a glass that already contains ice. He then adds a white powdered sugar from a plastic bag and an orange‑colored ingredient from a small jar, using a metal spoon. Next, he scoops a creamy ice‑cream‑like substance from a tub with a metal spoon and drops it into the same glass. He adds a few more ice cubes and a dash of the white powder into a second glass, places a martini glass nearby, and pours a liquor from a bottle into the martini glass. He picks up a shaker that is half‑filled with ice, shakes the mixture vigorously, and pours the chilled cocktail into the martini glass; he repeats the shaking and pouring a second time before presenting the finished drink.

action.detailed: He combines ice, powders, a creamy topping and liquor in a mixing glass, shakes the mixture in a shaker, and pours the resulting cocktail into a martini glass, performing the shake‑and‑pour sequence twice.
action.actor: a bald white man wearing a dark shirt, standing behind an outdoor bar

summary_sent_to_llm.title: Reeses Peanut Butter Cup Martini - TheFNDC.com
summary_sent_to_llm.description:
http://www.thefndc.com/ The Reese's Peanut Buter Cup Martini: heaven in a glass. What will you need to make this amazing cocktail? Peanut butter is a given, choclate vodka, creme de cacao, Frangelico, Kahlua, half and half, chocolate syrup, and Reeses peanut butter cups complete the ingredient list.

Coat a frosted martini glass with chocolate syrup, shake the rest of the ingredients with ice until the peanut butter is dissolved. Pour and garnish with peanut butter cups, eat the remaining Reeses, because you know you want to.

Thanks to viewer tenhundredkills for sending us this request.

REES
summary_sent_to_llm.root_summary: The video opens with a close‑up of a frosted martini glass holding a finished Reese’s Peanut Butter Cup Martini, the glass tipped slightly to the left. It then cuts to Johnny Diablo, who greets the audience and lists the ingredients: 1 oz each of Frangelico, Kahlua, crème de cacao, and chocolate vodka; 2 oz half‑and‑half; a heaping teaspoon of peanut butter; chocolate syrup; and Reese’s peanut‑butter cups for garnish. He measures one ounce of each liqueur, adds the peanut butter and half‑and‑half into a shaker, fills the shaker with ice, rims the frosted glass with chocolate syrup, and shakes vigorously until the peanut butter is fully dissolved and the mixture becomes fluffy. He strains the cocktail into the syrup‑rimmed glass, creates a small divot on a Reese’s cup and places the cup on the rim as garnish. He samples the drink, declares it delicious, thanks the viewer who requested it, shows a slide summarising the recipe, and the segment finishes with him opening a bottle of beer.

llm.system_prompt:
You evaluate YouTube videos for a video-understanding benchmark.

You will be given an Action100M-style summary of one video: title, description,
a hierarchical GPT-written summary of the whole video, and a deduplicated list
of action labels extracted at multiple levels of the video.

Your job is to judge:

1) DOMAINS — does this video clearly belong to any of these target domains?
   - "kitchen": a person preparing food in a kitchen-like setting
     (cooking, baking, food prep — NOT eating reviews, NOT pet-food prep,
     NOT food-product unboxing, NOT restaurant vlogs).
   - "manipulation": a person performing hand-object manipulation tasks
     with clear physical goals: assembly/disassembly, repair, crafting,
     tool use, packing, sorting. The video must show clear procedural
     manipulation, NOT just incidental hand movement (e.g. a vlog where
     someone holds things while talking does NOT count).
   - "navigation": the camera moves through a physical environment as an
     agent traverses space — first-person walking tours (museum, store,
     home, city street), driving / cycling / hiking POV footage, drone
     fly-throughs of indoor or outdoor scenes, room/house walkthroughs.
     The camera's translation through the environment IS the main content.
     Does NOT count: a stationary tripod with someone talking; a tutorial
     filmed in one place; b-roll where the camera only pans or zooms but
     does not translate; sports footage where the player moves but the
     camera stays put.
   A video can match zero, one, or multiple domains. Be strict — when in
   doubt, say "neither".

2) NUM_DISTINCT_EVENTS — count the number of *semantically distinct*
   sub-events (procedural steps) you see in the action list. Merge
   paraphrases of the same step into one. Ignore generic narration steps
   like "speak to camera" or "display title".

3) IS_GOOD_CANDIDATE — true only if BOTH:
   - at least one target domain matches
   - num_distinct_events > 3 (the video shows a real multi-step procedure)

Always return strict JSON in the requested schema.
